visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a white plate of dark preserved plums being held over a wooden tray next to a bowl of dried plums. An orange ceramic pot sits in the soft-focused background. Yellow text overlays introduce the ingredient weight. (2) Multiple quick cuts showcase the preparation of the syrup: a glass jar of plum wine, fresh yellow lemons, and water being poured into a white heart-shaped pot. The pot is placed on an induction cooktop, and dried plums are stirred into the boiling water with a wooden spoon. (3) On a bright yellow cutting board, dark purple preserved plums are sliced into pieces with a metal knife. The fruit is then added to the boiling pot along with brown sugar. The dark brown liquid is stirred thoroughly and then poured into a clear glass container to cool. (4) A pile of bright red cherry tomatoes is shown. Each tomato is carefully scored with a small knife. A mesh strainer is used to dip the tomatoes into boiling water for exactly fifteen seconds before they are plunged into a large bowl filled with cold water and ice. (5) The creator's hands are shown peeling the thin skins off the blanched tomatoes, leaving behind perfectly smooth red spheres. Sliced lemons are prepared on the wooden board. Lemon juice, chopped plums, and plum wine are added to the cooled dark syrup container. (6) The peeled tomatoes are packed into round glass storage jars. The plum syrup is ladled over them, followed by a drizzle of honey and several lemon slices. The jars are sealed with white plastic lids and stacked to be placed in a refrigerator for twenty-four hours. (7) A finished serving of pickled tomatoes is presented on a decorative ceramic plate with a sprig of green mint. A woman wearing a pink apron and white shirt is shown sitting at a wooden table, picking up a tomato with a small spoon and eating it with a happy expression. (8) The woman prepares a tall glass with ice and mint. She pours the dark plum syrup over the ice and adds a pickled tomato and a lemon slice. She is seen taking a large sip of the drink, smiling broadly at the camera while thumbs-up and variety text appear on screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 準備約70克的話梅. (2) [Subtitle]: 這次我增加一個配方『紫蘇梅』來增加梅子的風味！. (3) [Subtitle]: 『紫蘇梅』的湯汁. (4) [Subtitle]: 2-3顆的黃檸檬或蘋果醋. (5) [Subtitle]: 自釀的『梅酒』增添風味！. (6) [Subtitle]: 鍋裡加入1100ml的水. (7) [Subtitle]: 話梅放進來. (8) [Subtitle]: 慢慢的煮滾... (9) [Subtitle]: 滾了之後轉小火煮10分鐘. (10) [Subtitle]: 一旁把紫蘇梅的果肉切下來（這樣味道會比較容易釋放）. (11) [Subtitle]: 時間到後，把糖放進來...攪拌到溶解就可以關火了. (12) [Subtitle]: 先倒出來放涼. (13) [Subtitle]: 放涼備用. (14) [Subtitle]: 番茄洗淨用刀劃上四刀... (15) [Subtitle]: 水滾之後，放一部分番茄進來汆燙15秒. (16) [Subtitle]: 接著立刻放入冰水降溫再燙下一批... (17) [Subtitle]: 先泡1~2分鐘. (18) [Subtitle]: 把番茄皮撕掉... (19) [Subtitle]: 去好番茄皮的番茄 ❤️. (20) [Subtitle]: 兩顆檸檬切成四分之一. (21) [Subtitle]: 第三顆檸檬可以切片（不能用綠檸檬，會苦）. (22) [Subtitle]: 將檸檬汁擠到湯汁裡. (23) [Subtitle]: 紫蘇梅果肉跟籽都放進來. (24) [Subtitle]: 紫蘇梅湯汁... (25) [Subtitle]: 梅酒... (26) [Subtitle]: 攪拌攪拌... (27) [Subtitle]: 試喝一下味道若不夠甜可以再補... (28) [Subtitle]: 容器裡放入番茄接著再加入湯汁... (29) [Subtitle]: 可以擠一點蜂蜜... (30) [Subtitle]: 把檸檬片放上來... (31) [Subtitle]: 再補一點湯汁... (32) [Subtitle]: 像這樣就完成囉！❤️ ❤️. (33) [Subtitle]: 先放到冰箱冷藏24小時以上讓番茄入味！❤️. (34) [Subtitle]: 好期待明天的味道 ❤️ ❤️. (35) [Subtitle]: 冷藏一天的『梅漬番茄』. (36) [Subtitle]: 超級好吃的『梅漬番茄』就完成啦 ❤️. (37) [Subtitle]: 那我要開動囉～好冰～～哈 ❤️. (38) [Subtitle]: 酸酸甜甜的太好吃了～ ❤️. (39) [Subtitle]: 湯汁也超棒 ❤️. (40) [Subtitle]: 一點薄荷葉，撕碎 冰塊... (41) [Subtitle]: 梅漬番茄的湯汁... (42) [Subtitle]: 一點水稀釋（或不釋釋） 檸檬片... (43) [Subtitle]: 超好喝的夏日梅子飲就完成啦～ ❤️ ❤️ [Slogan]: 更多美味料理 請追蹤我 IG 臉書：羅潔塔的廚房 YouTube:@RosalinaKitchen

The music remains consistent in tempo and mood, creating a lively backdrop for the cooking process. (3) Sharp, rhythmic thudding sounds of a knife hitting a wooden cutting board are heard as plums are sliced. The BGM continues without interruption. The sounds of sugar being stirred into the liquid create a soft, swirling acoustic texture. (4) The distinctive clinking of ice cubes against a glass bowl and the sound of water splashing are prominent. These incidental noises are sharp and clean. The acoustic guitar rhythm in the BGM provides a continuous driving force through the montage. (5) A friendly female voice enters with a bright, cheerful tone and high arousal. Her speech is clear and animated as she describes the tasting experience. Overlapping with the music, her laughter and the final clinking of ice in a glass signify the conclusion.
